english.title: Intentionally obstruct an inspector enforcing the Regulations in relation to equine identification
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed an inspector, namely **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), acting in the course of enforcing the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019 Regulations or Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(a) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
